announce.text: Dispatch: Auditor Pell will inspect the premises. Please tidy the evidence.

inspect.text: Auditor Pell requests a clean room. We have not been told what that is.

hide.label: Hide the pollution (30 plates of tarp)
hide.text: The tarp is noted. So is the shape under it.

show.label: Show everything (fine: 10% of debt as interest)

tour.label: Offer a tour of the dump
tour.text: Auditor Pell has sat down. Nobody offered him a chair.
